applies_why: The judge text evaluates D5/C5 and expressly says the material was answered in named rounds, so the rule governing unanswered-witness counting applies.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: unanswered witness — one reading: any verse mentioned in the judge's line counts unless the earlier pressing sentence is quoted and round named; other reading: a verse expressly said to be answered is not counted.
why: The judge text says the D5/C5 material was answered in CR2 and CR3, so under K-G4 those verses are not counted as unanswered witnesses, and it does not treat any cited verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
